title: Möbius-Type Structures in Non-Orientable Singular Semi-Riemannian Manifolds
summary: Our objective is to illuminate the global structure of non-orientable manifolds with signature-changing metrics, with particular emphasis on global topological obstructions. Using explicit geometric constructions based on the topology of the Möbius strip, we produce examples of crosscap manifolds where the gluing junction coincides with the locus of signature change. Our main result shows that on non-orientable compact surfaces, the radical of such metrics cannot be everywhere transverse along the hypersurface of signature change.
